claims: Water is an inorganic compound with the formula H₂O.
Water covers 75% of Earth.
Safe drinking water typically has a pH around 6.5-8.5.
Water constitutes roughly 70% of the human body and cells.
Pure water is neutral with a pH of 7.
Drinking water usually ranges from 6.5 to 8.5 pH.
Tap water is provided by municipal systems.
Tap water is often treated.
Tap water is required to meet EPA standards.
Purified water has had impurities removed.
Mineral water contains natural minerals.
Water is a chemical compound with the formula H₂O.
Water consists of two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to one oxygen atom.
Liquid water is clear.
Liquid water is tasteless.
Liquid water is odorless.
Liquid water is colorless.
Water exists as a solid (ice).
Water exists as a gas (vapor).
Over 2 billion people experience water scarcity.
Less than 1% of Earth's water is available for human use.
The UN recognizes access to safe and affordable water as a human right.
Cholera is a water-borne illness.
Typhoid is a water-borne illness.
The Virginia Department of Health advises that boiling is the preferred method for in-home emergency water treatment.
